ascii-readability.name: ASCII Readability Check
ascii-readability.intro: Estimate the share of ASCII and printable characters in text to judge encoding and content readability.

base32.name: Base32 Encoded Length Estimator
base32.intro: Estimate the encoded string length from input bytes per Base32 rules for transfer and storage capacity planning.

base58.name: Base58 Checked Length
base58.intro: From raw byte length, estimate the Base58-encoded string length including the 4-byte checksum, as used for Bitcoin-style addresses.

base64-length.name: Base64 Encoded Length
base64-length.intro: Estimate the Base64 character count from input bytes (3 bytes to 4 chars) to gauge transfer and storage overhead.

base64-size.name: Base64 Encoded Size
base64-size.intro: Estimate the Base64 output size in KB including line-break overhead, with header and padding options.

binary-to-ascii.name: Binary / Hex to ASCII
binary-to-ascii.intro: Paste a continuous bit or hex string and choose the radix to decode it into ASCII text (8 bits or 2 hex digits per character).

calc-1.name: Base64 Encode / Decode
calc-1.intro: Encode and decode Base64 and Base64URL, correctly handling Unicode text.

calc-2.name: URL Encode / Decode
calc-2.intro: Encode URL components with encodeURIComponent or decode a full URL.

checksum-collision.name: Checksum Collision Probability
checksum-collision.intro: Estimate the undetected-error probability from checksum bit width and data volume; suitable for random errors only, not adversarial tampering.

compression-ratio.name: Data Compression Ratio
compression-ratio.intro: Compute the compression ratio and rate from original and compressed sizes to quantify compression effectiveness.

crc-error-rate.name: CRC Error-Detection Capability
crc-error-rate.intro: Estimate undetected-error probability and overhead from CRC width (e.g. 16 or 32) and channel bit error rate, comparing CRC-16 with CRC-32.

crc.name: CRC Checksum Width
crc.intro: Look up the checksum width and hex length for common CRC standards (CRC-8, CRC-16, CRC-32) for protocol design.

encode-2.name: Hamming Distance Estimator
encode-2.intro: Estimate the differing-bit count of two equal-length binary strings for error-correction and link-reliability analysis.

encode-3.name: Hash Output Length
encode-3.intro: Look up the output length (bytes and bits) of common hash algorithms (MD5, SHA family) for hash value storage planning.

encode-4.name: Morse Code Transmission Time
encode-4.intro: Convert an English word or character sequence into Morse dot/dash and gap timings to estimate total transmission time.

encode-5.name: QR Code Version Capacity
encode-5.intro: Estimate the minimum QR version and capacity level from character count and encoding mode (numeric, alphanumeric, byte).

encode-6.name: Radix Conversion Digits
encode-6.intro: Compute the number of digits an integer needs in a target radix (2-36), comparing binary and hex compactness.

encode-7.name: Hash Collision Probability
encode-7.intro: Estimate birthday-paradox collision probability from hash-space bits and stored item count; risk rises sharply as n approaches the square root of 2^bits.

encode.name: Caesar Cipher Shift
encode.intro: Shift English letters by 0-25 to demonstrate the Caesar cipher, for teaching classical substitution ciphers.

encoding-redundancy.name: Encoding Redundancy
encoding-redundancy.intro: Compare average code length with source entropy to compute redundancy (avgLen - H) / H; lower redundancy means a better code.

hamming-bits.name: Hamming Code Parity Bits
hamming-bits.intro: Compute the Hamming parity bits r from data bits m using 2^r >= m + r + 1 for single-bit error correction.

html.name: HTML Entity Length
html.intro: Estimate the escaped length when special characters (&, <, >, quotes, etc.) are converted to HTML entities.

huffman-avg-length.name: Huffman Average Code Length
huffman-avg-length.intro: Estimate the average code length and compression efficiency from symbol frequencies per Huffman coding.

image-to-base64.name: Image to Base64
image-to-base64.intro: Convert an image locally to a Base64 string with preview, size display and one-click copy for embedding in HTML/CSS.

jwt-size.name: JWT Length Estimator
jwt-size.intro: Estimate the encoded JWT length from header, payload and signature sizes (Base64 inflates by about 33%).

radix-digits.name: Radix Digit Count
radix-digits.intro: Compute the minimum digits needed to represent N states in a chosen radix (e.g. 256 states need 2 hex digits).

shannon-entropy.name: Shannon Entropy
shannon-entropy.intro: Compute Shannon entropy H (bits/symbol) from discrete source symbol probabilities (probabilities should sum to 1; zero-probability terms count as 0).

url-encoded-length.name: URL Encoded Length Estimator
url-encoded-length.intro: Estimate the RFC 3986 encoded length of a URL containing CJK, spaces or symbols (only alphanumerics and -_.~ are safe).

url.name: URL Encoding Space Overhead
url.intro: Estimate the percent-encoding size growth of a URL or query string to anticipate parameter bloat in links.

utf-8.name: UTF-8 Byte Count
utf-8.intro: Estimate the UTF-8 byte size from counts of ASCII and multibyte characters (CJK, emoji) for storage estimation.
